name: fgo-pet-agent
description: Explicitly paired FGO Pet task and goal reporting for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use Fgo Pet Agent in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Fgo Pet Agent reports user-confirmed task and goal outcomes over a current-user-only local Relay. Pairing and approval are explicit; no credentials are passed through Codex configuration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use FGO Pet only after explicit user confirmation; if pairing is pending, ask the user to approve the adapter in FGO Pet settings.
